Container.Name: dango
Container.Overview:
Dango is a lightweight, local-first anime media client and tracker designed for performance, privacy, and low resource usage. It lets you explore anime metadata, manage personal watchlists, view viewing statistics, and synchronize watch progress with AniList, MyAnimeList, Google Drive, and GitHub.
[b]Default WebUI:[/b] http://[IP]:3000 [b]Persistent Data:[/b] All databases, settings, and sync manifests are stored under /config/dango/ (mapped to /mnt/user/appdata/dango by default).

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web interface port accessible from your browser.

Config.Name: Appdata Storage
Config.Description: Location on your Unraid server where Dango stores the SQLite database (anime.db), sync tokens, and config files.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file permissions (Unraid default: 99 / nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file permissions (Unraid default: 100 / users).
